about: Every page template, the designed block it follows, and how far its redesign has got. Designed fields (block, basis, spec, status, extra_macros, note) are written by the designers; derived fields (reference, allowed_macros, extends, macros, controls) are regenerated by python scripts/check_design_map.py --write. basis: rule = first assignment by template path, to be confirmed page by page; reviewed = assigned by a designer looking at the page; declared = taken from the page's own design-block marker.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.job: See the state of an area at a glance and go to what needs attention.

data-table.title: Data table
data-table.job: Find, filter and act on many records of one kind.

record-detail.title: Record detail
record-detail.job: Read everything about one record, see what it is linked to, and act on it.

form.title: Form
form.job: Create or change one record, with each field labelled above it and errors beside it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.job: Change how the organisation, an integration or an account behaves, one section at a time.

chat.title: Chat
chat.job: Ask a question in words and get a grounded answer with its sources.

board.title: Board
board.job: Arrange and move items on a surface: Kanban columns, the capability map, a diagram canvas.

onboarding.title: Onboarding
onboarding.job: Sign up, sign in and take the first steps, one short screen at a time.

public.title: Public page
public.job: Explain the product, its price and its terms to someone not signed in.

empty-state.title: Empty state
empty-state.job: Say plainly why there is nothing here, or what went wrong, and offer the next step.

app/templates/archimate_views/traceabili.note: Matrix page with overview tiles and a coverage bar above the table; the card and progress macros are the library ones.
